messages.subject: epoched sleep/wake time series
parts:
Hello again, 
We have managed to run GGIR on gt3x data with 2 nights of recording (nights only). However, when we extracted the time series data from part 5, the SPT was mostly 0, not matching up to the part4 summary file. We have the codes as below:
l
oglocation="Raw/GGIR_trial/sleeplog.csv", 
  sleeplogidnum=FALSE,
  nnights=2,
  def.noc.sleep=1,
  colid=1,
  coln1=2,
  sleepwindowType ="TimeInBed",
  HASIB.algo = "ColeKripke1992", #"ColeKripke1992", #change to other if desired, 'VanHees2015' default
  Sadeh_axis = "Y",
  ignorenonwear=TRUE,
  relyonguider=TRUE,
  sleeplogsep=",",
  includenightcrit=5, #minimum number of hour to count as a valid night, can be lower
  includedaycrit=1, #minimum number of hour to count as a valid day, can be lower
  #=====================
  #run part 5 as default
  save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE,
  save_ms5raw_format="csv",

We ran these code on 2 separate subjects, the csv file found in the first ms5.outraw/40_100_400 was actually empty (part 4 ran normally), and for the second subject the csv file in ms5.outraw looks alright but has mostly 0 for sleeptime. I have attached the raw csv and part 4 summary csv from the second subject here. 
please let me know how we can correct these errors. Thank you!

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: epoched sleep/wake time series
parts:
Hi Eva,

If your protocol instructed participants to only wear accelerometers during nighttime, then I would say that part 5 reports are not informative for you as GGIR would only provide sleep-related outcomes (part 4 reports).

Part 5 classifies valid and invalid days based on the argument "includedaycrit.part5", which is 2/3 by default (requiring 2/3 of the waking time to be valid to include that day). Also, by default, part 5 timeseries would skip the invalid days, see argument "save_ms5raw_without_invalid" which is TRUE as default. Then, I think GGIR is not storing the SPTs in the timeseries because all your days are being classified as invalid. I guess that you can fix that by setting "save_ms5raw_without_invalid = FALSE" and/or setting "includedaycrit.part5 = 0", but I have never tried this.

Hope this helps!

Best,
Jairo
